title: Met' Erotic Anthology: A
body:
It had just gotten dark
<g id="1">On the beach</g>
On our own beach-
Where we first kissed
Lying in the sand
Around silence, silence
We silent
You broke your silence
With complaint
"When will he write me something", you answered me

" I have told you, beloved, that the lyrics
They come to me suddenly and by chance, "I replied

You smirked.
Two or three jokes followed.
Unsubstantial.

The manoeuvre is elaborate.

Passed by. Maybe
forgotten.
But I didn't forget.
So I wrote to you...

As the wave crashes sweetly on the coastline
and as the podium finds rhythm in the music
So my heart rhythmically
for you it will only ring
‘That night

The last night of April
At sunrise
Grillis and Ai-Georgitis
It would be followed by the last month of Spring
In May
In May
With his wreath
With his struggles
With the Flowers of

Inspiration

You thought I forgot
But I didn't forget
So I wrote to you...

As May always follows April
and as the earth revolves around the Sun
So my body will be wandering around
to find you asking
